repair_policy: Do not rewrite historical receipts merely to remove warnings.
Use a new hash-bound strict release when a note requires evidence re-publication or a legal/currentness change.
Use a focused navigation release for semantically justified inbound links only.
Keep unresolved notes excluded from assistance retrieval until reviewed evidence is resolved.
Require independent review and human approval for every repair release.
success_criteria: Every listed lineage finding has a disposition: repaired by new receipt, superseded, or explicitly quarantined.
Every orphan has a reviewer decision with an existing target or a documented no-link decision.
No source/, ingest/ or active-vault file is changed by the diagnostic itself.
A rerun is deterministic and produces no unexplained new warning.
